name: Macro keypad
tagline: Engineered Maker Build: "USB mechanical macro keypad with rotary encoder and OLED display on Arduino Pro Micro"
summary: Complete physical hardware build tailored for USB mechanical macro keypad with rotary encoder and OLED display on Arduino Pro Micro. Includes selected maker sensors and actuators, snap-fit 3D printable enclosure, color-coded wiring diagram, and verified Arduino firmware.

parts.name: Arduino Uno R3
parts.why: Central microcontroller running real-time sensor polling and actuator logic.

parts.name: 5V High-Power LED Lamp Module
parts.why: Diffused high-efficiency LED illuminator for night light or signaling.

parts.name: 0.96 inch I2C OLED Display (SSD1306)
parts.why: High-contrast 128x64 graphical screen for visual gauges and telemetry.

parts.name: 18650 Li-ion Battery Holder with Protection
parts.why: Enables portable operation with integrated over-discharge cutoff.

buildSteps: Step 1: 3D print the snap-fit chassis with 20% infill using PLA or PETG.
Step 2: Mount the Arduino Uno R3 and secure the standoff clips.
Step 3: Wire peripheral power rails (5V / GND) and route analog/digital signal leads according to the wiring diagram.
Step 4: Connect the display HUD and verify pin assignments.
Step 5: Flash firmware via Arduino IDE or WebSerial and inspect live telemetry over UART.
